text.p: These are the leading stories in the Egyptian press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Prime Minister Kamal Ganzouri hands Syrian President Hafez al-Assad a letter from President Hosni Mubarak during his visit to Syria. Mubarak met with Ganzouri, Foreign Minister Amr Moussa and Information Minister Safwat el-Sherif before their departure to Latakia for important talks. The letter deals with latest developments in the region.

- Tourist projects, with total investment cost of 15 billion pounds ($4.4 billion) have been approved from January, 1996, up to February, 1997, Tourism Minister Mamdouh el-Beltagi says. The projects will create 27,000 new jobs, he adds.
- Mubarak receives Bosnian leader Haris Silajdzic. After the meeting, Silajdzic says "We hope bilateral relations will be developed in various fields."
- Libyan envoy Colonel Mustafa Kharrubi gave Mubarak a letter from Libyan leader Muammar Gaddafi on bilateral ties and the current Arab situation.
- Ganzouri says a new discovery of iron ore has been found southeast of Aswan, 690 km (430 miles) south of Cairo.
